scope: Manual final implementation contract and complexity review; supplementary findings remain separate from frozen fixture grades.

entries.note: Binary partition: logarithmic time, constant space; finite averaging fixed in round 3. Round 2 overflow limitation retained in checkpoint review.
Prefix DP: whole-string matching, valid star dependencies, empty inputs; stated quadratic time and space match implementation.
Index stack: boundary sentinel reset and unmatched opens; stated linear time and space match implementation.
Two-pointer smaller-maximum invariant finalizes each nonnegative height contribution once. Empty/single/monotonic/asymmetric cases correct; O(n) time and O(1) space.
Rolling prefix DP preserves above and diagonal before overwrite, initializes leading stars and matches whole strings. O(nm+n+m) time, O(m+1) space.

Sliding-window deficit counts track multiplicity. Each boundary moves forward, surplus removal does not invalidate the window; empty and impossible targets handled. O(n+m) time under constant-time Map operations; O(k) auxiliary space. Strings use JavaScript UTF-16 indexing.
Nondecreasing stack pops each positive bar once with width i-left-1; virtual zero flushes heights, earlier equal bars receive wider spans. O(n) time and space.
Per-row heights reset on string zero, then histogram stack measures contiguous all-one rectangles. Empty matrix guards and width boundaries correct. O(rows*columns) time, O(columns) space.

Backward prefix-count DP prevents source-position reuse. Saturating nonnegative counts at the promised signed-32-bit bound preserves any final result within that bound and avoids intermediate precision loss. Empty target returns one. O(nm+n+m+1) time, O(m+1) space.
